content: Linear webhook delivery: retried max 3 times with backoff 1 min, 1 hr, 6 hr. A delivery counts as failed if the server is unavailable, takes >5000ms to respond, or returns non-200. If the URL continues unresponsive Linear MAY DISABLE the webhook, which must be re-enabled manually. Docs state no explicit per-workspace webhook count limit. Linear-Delivery UUID available for dedupe.
